text:
marie-cs: FYI we just got an escalation from a large APAC customer — multiple locales showing worse translation/formality after today's rollout (1.5.0). They say Japanese and Simplified Chinese replies turned overly casual and in some cases reverted to English. :rotating_light:

marie-cs: customer provided two request IDs and samples, pasted below. They raised a Sev2 because user-facing product flows broke.

marie-cs: Sample A (zh-CN):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-infer-1.5.0",
  "input": "请把下面这段话翻译成中文（简体），保持正式语气：Our partnership contract will be renewed on April 1. Please confirm availability."
}
```

marie-cs: Expected: a formal zh-CN translation. Actual returned: "We will renew the partnership contract on April 1. Can you confirm availability?" (English).

marie-cs: Sample B (ja):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-infer-1.5.0",
  "input": "次の文を日本語で敬語に翻訳してください：Your invoice was approved, thanks for the quick turnaround."
}
```

marie-cs: Expected a polite Japanese output. Actual: a short casual ja reply missing keigo and with awkward literalness.

sahil-eng: thanks — did they include the request-id headers? we need request ids, region, and exact client version. also when was 1.5.0 promoted?
\marie-cs: they sent request-ids: rq_0a1b2c3d and rq_0f9e8d7c. Region: ap-northeast-1. Client: web v2.3. Rolled to 30% at 2025-11-12T09:10:00Z per deploy notes.
\deploy-bot: Deployment event: redwood-infer-1.5.0 promoted to canary (30%) by tessa-pm at 2025-11-12T09:10:00Z.
\leo-ml: possible suspects: tokenizer change, language-detection tweak, or a fallback routing rule that sends short prompts to the lightweight family. small model often drops formality. will check model diffs.
\ethan-sre: we also got an alert from ap-northeast-1 for increased 5xxs around 09:12-09:18 UTC tied to autoscaler flips. Not sure if that caused routing to fallback variants.
\marie-cs: customer also mentioned spikes in latency and occasional 500s during the incident window, yes. they saw degraded UX then inconsistent language output.
\sahil-eng: prioritize repro: can anyone try the exact requests against 1.4.2 and 1.5.0 pinned endpoints? add &region=ap-northeast-1. capture X-Redwood-Request-ID and response headers (model-variant, quantization).
\leo-ml: reproducing locally now. quick note: 1.5.0 includes tokenizer patch TKN-42 (handles CJK punctuation) and a new language-detector threshold lowered to 0.6. if language detection dips it may force english fallback.
\leo-ml: local run results: with model redwood-infer-1.4.2 -> zh output formal as expected. with 1.5.0 -> returned English for the exact payload. request-id: rq-repro-112. header: X-Model-Variant: small-v2; X-Lang-Detect-Score: 0.58.
\marie-cs: so small-v2 was used — sounds like routing changed when instances were scaled down. customer saw similar header values in their responses.
\ethan-sre: digging into autoscaler logs. around rollout we had a node preempt in ap-northeast-1 which temporarily reduced GPU pool and triggered fallback policy to route some requests to small-v2 cheap pool.
	essa-pm: key decisions: we need quick mitigation and then a root cause. mitigations: 1) rollback 1.5.0 canary -> 1.4.2 for ap-northeast-1, 2) override routing to prefer medium/large variants for translation endpoints until we fix language-detector, 3) patch detector threshold.
\marie-cs: customer asked for ETA and whether we can revert for just their account. they are on an enterprise plan.
\sahil-eng: we can do per-tenant routing override, but need legal/ops signoff for emergency config. will queue it. meanwhile, can we patch language-detector config to raise threshold to 0.75 for CJK inputs? quick rollback of TKN-42 is riskier.
\leo-ml: patching threshold is fastest. I can push a hotfix to canary config in 20m and validate with repros. if that works, promote to 30% -> full.
\ethan-sre: I'm preparing a list of affected request-ids and timestamps to share with the customer for forensics. also enabling extra logging for model-variant routing decisions.
\marie-cs: customer requested steps to reproduce on their side — I pasted the minimal cURL they asked for:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "X-Region: ap-northeast-1" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-infer-1.5.0","input":"请把下面这段话翻译成中文（简体），保持正式语气：Our partnership contract will be renewed on April 1. Please confirm availability."}'
```

marie-cs: customer also asked if billing could be impacted — they saw token counts drop for some requests (shorter fallback outputs). billing is unaffected beyond lower token usage but UX regression is main concern.
\leo-ml: provisional root cause hypothesis: tokenizer patch changed how punctuation is tokenized for CJK; lowered language-detector score + autoscaler-induced routing to small-v2 caused fallbacks to English. Combo bug.
	essa-pm: plan: 1) leo patch threshold to 0.75 on canary config now, 2) ethan apply routing override for enterprise tenants flagged by marie (customer-id: ent-9932) to pin medium/large until fix, 3) roll back TKN-42 if threshold patch doesn't resolve, 4) postmortem.
\sahil-eng: logging: add correlation id capture (client request id -> internal request id -> node id -> model-variant) and share with customer. also include model checksum so they can confirm which revision served.
\ethan-sre: applied temporary routing override for ent-9932 at 2025-11-12T10:05:00Z. increased logging retention.
\leo-ml: pushed lang-detector hotfix to canary at 2025-11-12T10:12:00Z. running repro now...
\leo-ml: repro result: hotfix increases score to 0.82 and now 1.5.0 returns correct formal zh and polite ja. request-id: rq-repro-113.
\marie-cs: customer confirmed initial tests look good with the override. they're asking for timeline to full fix and whether we will credit them for the outage.
	essa-pm: we should offer a goodwill credit — ops/legal to advise. timeline: if hotfix validated, promote to remaining canary and full within 4-6 hours, monitor. rollback of tokenizer only if issues persist.
\marie-cs: I'll update the customer and keep thread open. tagging @sahil-eng @leo-ml @ethan-sre for followups. thanks everyone. :pray:
